messages:
lucy-sales: Heads-up 10am call with Kestrel Bank. They want EU-only processing, BYOK, and explicit chain-of-custody for egress certs + assurance that routing never leaves EU during normal ops. Need a 60s script and an ops checklist.

dan-presales: TL;DR: Hosted = regional preference only; Dedicated/Private = can be pinned with BYOK. Chain-of-custody + signed certs are part of ops onboarding. I'll keep it crisp.

omar-eng: Hosted detail: we prefer EU regions but keep multi-region fallback for availability; can't promise absolute containment on Hosted. Dedicated: can provision reserved pool in a single EU region and set routing to strict (no fallback). Private: full customer control. BYOK flow: key registration, policy review, test decrypts, allowlist of KMS IPs.

rachel-legal: Recorded subprocessors in EU: LogSafe, Observr, CloudGX. We can provide DPA, current subprocessor attestation, SOC2, and a signed attestation workbook if they require it. Avoid absolute "never" statements unless it's Private/on-prem.

yara-ops: Chain-of-custody for egress certs: we can provide cert fingerprints, rotation cadence, and signed delivery receipts during onboarding. For strict customers we can deliver a signed manifest and notarized export log. That is an add-on.

lucy-sales: (typo) meant to ask: can we state a line for Hosted and one for Dedicated they can sign off on? Conservative wording please.

omar-eng: Hosted (conservative): "Redwood processes customer workloads primarily in EU regions; in exceptional capacity or recovery events requests may be routed to a compatible region; Redwood will notify the customer and provide mitigation options."

omar-eng: Dedicated (conservative): "Redwood will provision dedicated capacity in the customer-specified EU region and operate under region-pinning; processing and storage will remain in that region except for minimal control-plane metadata required for platform health and auditing."

rachel-legal: Also add: "Customer may request DPA, current subprocessor list, and a signed attestation workbook; Redwood will provide standard compliance artifacts on request."

sam-pricing: Ballpark for procurement: one-time setup ~$39k, committed monthly for a 2x A100 dedicated pool ~$18k/mo, BYOK + signed attestation & COC manifest add-on ~$6k/yr. Final depends on throughput/retention and SLA terms.

yara-ops: KMS onboarding estimate: 7-21 days for key exchange, policy review, and test flows. For signed chain-of-custody & notarized manifests add 1-2 weeks. Private/on-prem adds 4-8 weeks.

yara-ops: Ops handoff checklist (I'll create PROJ-71102): 1) Confirm exact EU region (eu-west1/eu-central1) 2) Collect KMS key IDs + rotation policy + allowlist CIDRs 3) Request signed subprocessor attestation + DPA 4) Define egress cert fingerprint delivery & rotation cadence + chain-of-custody manifest 5) Agree audit log export cadence & retention 6) Define SLA failure modes, runbook, and contractual remedies.

cert-bot: Ticket PROJ-71102 created and assigned to @yara-ops.

lucy-sales: Great, I'll use the Hosted + Dedicated lines, mention pricing & timeline, and promise PROJ-71102 follow-up with attestation & COC. I'll post any redlines after the call. :thumbsup:
